GraceChangeDesignContext.Rationale: This is the M0.8 entry gate. It addresses audit finding F12 and prevents later packages from relying on stale readiness claims, missing GRACE linkage, or a composite branch being treated as one verified release.

Alternatives.Alternative: Continue implementation and fix documentation later. Rejected because agents would compound false support and trust-boundary assumptions.
Rewrite the current branch into a perfect history first. Rejected because published history is useful evidence and the problem is semantic integration, not commit aesthetics.

DeferredDecisions.Decision: Whether coarse graph modules should split is deferred until the mapping demonstrates independent ownership and verification.
Merge and cherry-pick mechanics for P0 through P3 remain outside this change.

Scenarios.Scenario: An agent asks whether browser.query works through CEF and receives an exact support-state answer with source and test evidence.
A reviewer follows a GRACE module to real implementation files and its named verification without inferring readiness from prose.
